title: Solo dev here, my 4 player strategy game where the voice, music and sound are ElevenLabs and AI helps me with code
author: Wladaaaaa
selftext:
Hi, I'm solo dev from Serbia. I work in software for 18 years, but this is the first game I ever made. Development took one year, around 9 months of that I was actively working on it. Inspiration was Rampart, I played it a lot when I was kid. I posted here few weeks ago, now the free demo is on Steam and so far people give me positive feedback.



Game is called Quadfort. Up to 4 players, you can play on couch on one screen, online or solo against AI. Everyone have island with ring of walls. You deploy cannons, then siege where everybody shoot everybody, then you have 16 seconds to fix your ring. If ring is not closed you get strike, after 3 strikes you are out. In video is one wave like that with 4 AI players.



The announcer, music and sound effects are from ElevenLabs. I generated a lot of takes, kept only few and edited them. For code I use Claude every day. It writes a lot, but I test everything and throw away a lot too. Game is in Unity and has over 3000 tests now. AI players in the game are normal game AI, no LLM there.



Idea, rules and balance decisions are mine, and playtesting is still me playing for hours :D



Demo is free, first two parts of campaign, Skirmish vs AI and online 1v1 with friend:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4684430/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=post&utm\_campaign=demo&utm\_content=r-aigamedev](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4684430/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=demo&utm_content=r-aigamedev)



Full game will have 3-4 players on one screen, 4 players online, Hard AI and the rest of the campaign. If you like the demo, wishlist helps me a lot.



If somebody want to know more about the workflow, ask.
